description: Read one job's current status. Use after hydracept_submit_job or hydracept_run with wait=false; use hydracept_get_receipt after success. If the job id is unknown, use hydracept_jobs_find first. Requires bearer key. No charge. Returns: HydraceptJob status projection for the jobId. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND.

job_id.description: Required job id from hydracept_run or hydracept_submit_job.
job_id.title: Job Id

name: hydracept_job_status
title: Read job status
